title: Bihar Cop Takes Scooty 'Ki Chabi', Drags Pregnant Woman In Shocking Video: 'Chadha Dijiye, Record Kariye Pura' | Viral News - News18
text: A couple’s late-night outing in Patna took an unexpected turn when an argument with a policeman grew into a tense situation on Marine Drive. What happened between the officer and a pregnant woman on the road was recorded on camera, and the video of it is now being widely circulated online. According to a report in Bhaskar English, the woman and her husband had gone for a walk and had entered the wrong side while pushing their scooter. They said the proper U-turn was too far ahead, which is why they decided to walk the vehicle instead of riding it. The report stated that a patrolling officer stopped them, checked the papers and found a pending challan of Rs 12,000, after which the situation escalated. Policeman Drags Pregnant Woman The report mentioned that the officer planned to take the scooter to the police station because of the unpaid challan. The couple tried explaining that they knew entering the wrong side was a mistake. But when the policeman sat on the scooter to take it away, the woman moved in front of the vehicle and refused to let him drive off. The video shows the officer trying to move while she stands in front of the scooter. At one point, she asks her companion to record everything. She says, “Nahi challenge paidal. Hum bhi esi par jayenge. Hum aapke sath baithenge. (We will not walk. We will also go on this. We will sit with you)." The footage captures the woman repeatedly shouting as the scooter inches forward and brushes against her. She keeps demanding that the recording continue and says, “Chadha dije, video banaiye inki. Chadhaiye. Humko kaise nahi lekar ja rahe? (Go ahead, record him. Go on. How are you not taking me?)" People nearby watch while the argument continues on the road. The clip also shows another policeman stepping in and speaking to the man accompanying her. The woman continues to stand in front of the scooter until she eventually climbs onto the back seat while still shouting and arguing. The officer then drives the scooter ahead with her sitting behind him. Watch The Clip Here What People Said Online The video drew immediate responses, with one user commenting, “Traffic rules don’t give anyone the right to treat citizens without dignity. This incident deserves strict action." Another said, “It is the fault of the woman, but have some mercy, she is pregnant." Someone else shared a different view, saying, “Victim card played. Clearly, she has broken the rule and why is she coming in front of the bike when the police are trying to seize it?" What The Woman Claimed As per the report, the woman said that the officer pushed her more than once and that the scooter’s bumper hit her stomach as he tried to move. She also told people around that she and her husband were coming from Gandhi Maidan after eating at a restaurant and had taken the wrong side only because they were looking for water and cold drinks. She said they were walking with the scooter because they knew about the mistake. What Happened After Reaching The Police Station According to the report, the couple apologised at the police station and promised that they would clear the pending challan within 15 days. After this assurance, the police returned the scooter to them and allowed them to leave.
